description:
Enable R8 code shrinking and resource shrinking for the release build of the WeatherNow project. The project uses Gson for JSON parsing and Retrofit for network calls. You must:

1. Modify `app/build.gradle` (or .kts) to set `minifyEnabled` and `shrinkResources` to `true` for the `release` build type.
2. Modify `app/proguard-rules.pro` to add keep rules that preserve:
   - All classes in `com.example.weathernow.data.model` package (Gson models)
   - All fields annotated with `@SerializedName`
   - The Retrofit service interface `com.example.weathernow.data.api.WeatherApiService`
3. Verify the project builds successfully with these changes using `./gradlew assembleRelease`.

Note: A signing config using the debug keystore has already been pre-configured for the release build type, so you only need to focus on the shrinking configuration.
